question: How do bondage and freedom stand from his autonomy?
premises: From his autonomy, more now, no reply — we babble, mounted on the palace-course of the famed waves of the consciousness-ocean.
Peace thereof; thereupon that, this one designated bondage, thereby of fully-drunk relish: freedom of the stated form.
inference: Autonomy silences reply into ocean-mounted babble, while the bondage-named turns freedom-relished.
plain_english: From his autonomy — more now, no reply — we babble, mounted on the palace-course of the famed waves of the consciousness-ocean. Peace thereof; thereupon that — this one designated by the name bondage — thereby thus of fully-drunk relish: freedom, of the stated form.
